traits.note: Tall neck, two humps and a tapering tail, but the pose is upright and stocky.
Head is smallish and snakelike, but has small ears or horns and fangs.
Four stubby legs with box feet, standing clear of the water, not paddle flippers.
Smooth glossy skin with no scales or fur.
Dark green, but too bright and teal, with no lighter belly.
Long neck rises almost straight up like the references.
Two egg-shaped humps in a row, but bulbous and too tall.
Head is small relative to the body, but has big glowing eyes and ear spikes.

fix: Replace the four box-footed legs with broad flat paddle flippers, and sink the body low so it sits in the water.
